notes.subject: is
notes.rationale: Hebrew lacks a copula between the shield pair and 'his faithfulness'

notes.subject: לָךְ
notes.rationale: the pronoun is second FEMININE singular while the surrounding verbs (יַצִּילְךָ, תֶּחְסֶה) are masculine — the addressed one shifts gender, perhaps a feminine community or a copyist's pointing

notes.subject: סֹחֵרָה
notes.rationale: occurs only here in the Tanakh; exact meaning unknown, probably a small surrounding shield — 'buckler' is a guess at the shape

notes.subject: pinion / wings
notes.rationale: the bird-of-prey picture — cf. Deuteronomy 32:11, the eagle spreading its wings over the nest — meeting the fowler's trap of verse 3

translation: With his pinion he will cover you, and under his wings you take refuge; large shield and buckler is his faithfulness.
